name: @engine/view-models
description: The view models the two sites keep (a work's record and condition, fuzzy dates, dimensions, images, cards, listing, discovery, editorial, the content blocks and the shell) and typed fixtures for them. Types and fixtures only: no runtime dependency. One entry for the types (`@engine/view-models`), one for the fixtures (`@engine/view-models/fixtures`); `./<module>` reaches a single file.
